label: early original-phase step after g/b in sequences starting with 0 (weak, diffuse)
explanation: Very sparse (0.03% of steps), weak (max 0.24). Fires only in the original phase at t=3..7, mostly t=3-5, plus a little at the delimiter step. It never fires in the copy phase or at t<3. The strongest lifts are prev_tok g or b (about 10x, together about 62% of mass), a 0/1/n as the first token (0 gives 11x), the digit 0 appearing early, and in_first=1. Top examples look like "0 g b [x]" and "n 0 g g [x]". No conjunction of these gets precision above about 13%: most steps matching g/b + early 0 + t=3-5 stay silent, and about 70% of the activation mass falls outside the best predicate. The feature looks like a diffuse hidden-state conjunction with no clean token-level description. Best dev F1 is about 0.13.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: prev_tok=g (+5.56), prev_tok=b (+5.46), orig0=1 (+4.94), orig0=0 (+4.80), orig0=n (+4.50), prev2_tok=g (+4.13). Lower it: phase=2 (-5.88), prev3_tok=- (-3.63), t=8 (-3.21), prev3_tok=c (-2.70).
